d: An anthropomorphic feline creature with a muscular, heavy build, featuring charcoal grey fur and a mature, stern expression. The face is marked with golden yellow stripes across the forehead and cheeks, complemented by narrow, glowing yellow eyes. The attire consists of a dark blue sleeveless tunic and matching baggy trousers, layered with a cream-colored fabric wrap around the waist, cream-colored baggy leggings with blue spiral symbols, and lace-up cream sandals. Accessories include a golden spiked pauldron on the left shoulder, a dark maroon scarf, and a large sword sheathed on the back. Visible non-human traits include pointed golden-brown feline ears and a long, thin charcoal grey tail. BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
